excerpt: A permanent electric dipole moment (EDM) of a particle or system is a separation of charge along its angular-momentum axis and is a direct signal of T-violation and, assuming CPT symmetry, CP violation.
publisher: arXiv (preprint); T. Chupp, P. Fierlinger, M. Ramsey-Musolf, J. Singh
title: Electric Dipole Moments of the Atoms, Molecules, Nuclei and Particles
